need: Written before opening the document: I need the passage where Jevons states his central paradox — that burning coal more economically does not lower how much of it the country burns, but raises it.
query: rendering its employment more profitable the present demand for coal is increased

alternates.quote: On the contrary, by rendering its employment more profitable, the present demand for coal is increased and the advantage is more strongly thrown upon the side of those who will in the future have the cheapest supplies

chain.title: The Coal Question; an enquiry concerning the progress of the Nation, and the probable exhaustion of our coal-mines
chain.author: William Stanley Jevons
